title: Max Lab expands diagnostic services in Uttar Pradesh with Moradabad laboratory
summary: The facility will offer a range of tests, including pathology, genomics and oncology diagnostics, to expand access to diagnostic services in Tier II cities
thbAction: Pitch THB's diagnostics CRM to help labs manage doctor outreach, collection-center expansion, and B2B referral relationships while improving conversion and retention.
contentHtml:
The facility will offer a range of tests, including pathology, genomics and oncology diagnostics, to expand access to diagnostic services in Tier II cities

Max Lab, the diagnostic services arm of Max Healthcare, has expanded its presence in Uttar Pradesh with the opening of a diagnostic laboratory in Moradabad. The expansion aims to strengthen access to diagnostic services in emerging healthcare markets and bring testing services closer to patients beyond metropolitan cities.

With demand for diagnostic services in Tier II cities, the new laboratory will offer a range of tests to patients and healthcare providers. Equipped with diagnostic technology and supported by quality protocols, the facility will cater to testing requirements ranging from routine pathology investigations to specialised tests, including advanced genomics and oncology diagnostics.

Diagnostics play a role in clinical decision-making, early disease detection and treatment planning. Through its diagnostic infrastructure in Moradabad, Max Lab aims to support clinicians with test results to facilitate clinical decisions and patient management. The initiative also aligns with the focus on preventive healthcare and early diagnosis, as the burden of lifestyle-related and chronic diseases continues to rise.

Commenting on the expansion, Arpan Malhotra, Director and COO, Max Lab, said, “The expansion of our diagnostic network in Moradabad is an important step towards making quality and advanced diagnostic services more accessible to people in Tier II cities. Diagnostics play a pivotal role in healthcare, with a significant proportion of clinical decisions guided by test results. As awareness around preventive healthcare increases and the burden of chronic diseases continues to grow, access to timely, accurate and reliable testing becomes even more important. At Max Lab, our focus remains on a ‘Patient First’ approach, supported by advanced technology, stringent quality standards and a commitment to delivering reliable diagnostic services closer to the communities we serve.”

With a presence across more than 60 cities and a network of over 1,700 patient touchpoints, Max Lab continues to expand its diagnostic footprint across the country. Through its network and test portfolio, the organisation aims to expand access to diagnostics while addressing the healthcare needs of patients and medical practitioners across India.
